summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives Loschmidt constant (273.15 K, 100 kPa) as 2.651 645 804... × 10^25 m^-3, with uncertainty (exact).
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives Loschmidt constant (273.15 K, 100 kPa) as 2.651 645 804... × 10^25 m^-3, with uncertainty (exact). The 2022 listing marks the value exact. An exact row is fixed by the adjustment's definitions. It is not a new laboratory measurement printed with an uncertainty. The Loschmidt constant is the number density of an ideal gas at the stated temperature and pressure. The row is marked exact.
